children: Vince Holding Corp., (Nasdaq: VNCE) (“VNCE” or the “Company”), a global retail platform, today announced that the Company is scheduled to participate in a fireside chat at the Noble Capital Markets Emerging Growth Virtual Equity Conference on Friday, October 2, 2026, at 2:30 PM Eastern Time.
A webcast of the presentation will be available in the “Investors” section of the Company’s website at
. The webcast will be archived and available on the website shortly after the event.

Vince Holding Corp. is a global retail platform that operates the Vince brand women's and men's ready to wear business and the October’s Very Own (“OVO”) brand apparel and accessories business. Vince, established in 2002, is a leading global luxury apparel and accessories brand best known for creating elevated yet understated pieces for every day effortless style. Vince operates 42 full-price retail stores, 12 outlet stores, and its e-commerce site,

, as well as through premium wholesale channels globally. OVO is a Canadian lifestyle brand originally founded in 2008 by Aubrey “Drake” Graham and a Toronto collective offering premium apparel and accessories. OVO operates 12 flagship retail stores worldwide and its e-commerce site,
. Please visit investors.vince.com for more information.
This press release is also available on the Vince Holding Corp. website (http://investors.vince.com/).
